questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Malaysia?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Malaysia article.

questions.proof: Kuala Lumpur is the national capital, largest city and the seat of the legislative branch of the federal government.
